test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: How can you insert a blank row at the top of a worksheet?

options.text: Click on the row number and press the Delete key on the keyboard
Right-click on the row number and select Insert
Drag the mouse on the row border to select the row and click Insert in the Cells group on the Home tab
Click on the row number and press the Insert key on the keyboard.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Right-click on the row number and select Insert**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Right-click on the row number and select Insert** to add a blank row at the top of a worksheet.
 
• Clicking on the row number highlights the entire row.
 
• Right-clicking provides a context menu with various options, including the "Insert" option.
 
• Selecting "Insert" will add a new blank row above the selected row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Inserting a row can also be done using the "Insert" command in the "Cells" group on the "Home" tab.
 
• Shortcut keys such as "Ctrl + Shift + +" can also be used to insert rows quickly.
 
• Inserting rows can be useful for adding new data or creating space for headers and titles.
